title: German Sausage Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole filled with sausage and topped with a crispy jubilant crust.
instructions: Cook the sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, carrots, and potatoes to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the beer (if using) and bring to a simmer.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with the casserole and jubilant cheese.
Bake until the cheese is bubbly and golden brown, about 20 minutes.
Optional: garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or chives.
